audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read "Talon" while content win[N] reads Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly, and five of the seven phases[N].why sentences describe Hwei winning the stage they sit under.
audit.corrected: All seven sides realigned as one atomic group; phases[4].why rewritten so the level 6 row reads as the even fight its new side claims.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text calls Rake the reset ability and phases[4].why describes level 6 as Hwei's all-in window.
audit.why: The cooldown-and-health refund is on Noxian Diplomacy (Q, 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, 575 range) and only on a kill. Rake is W, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s at 650. Shadow Assault is 100/80/60s at 550 range — his level 6 spike is a commit, and yours opens at 1300.
audit.corrected: Reset attributed to Q, and the level 6 row rewritten around the 1300-vs-550 range gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer names Talon's ultimate "Assassinate" in five places (spikes[1], whys[4], mid, wants.you[1], wants.foe[1]) and credits it with engaging off-screen through walls. wants.you[2] tells you to save "W (Severance)" to root him mid-dash.
audit.why: Talon's R is Shadow Assault — a 550-range ring of blades with invisibility, no terrain traversal at all. The wall-vault is Assassin's Path (E), 725 range, which has no meaningful cooldown of its own but puts each used piece of terrain on a long one. Hwei's W subspells are Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection and Stirring Lights — there is no ability called Severance anywhere in his kit, and W shields, it does not root.
audit.corrected: Every "Assassinate" replaced with the correct ability for what the sentence describes — Assassin's Path for the flank, Shadow Assault for the burst — and the fabricated Severance root replaced with the W shield paint.

audit.why: The numbers that matter are Rake at 9s falling to 7s, Noxian Diplomacy at 8s falling to 6s, and Shadow Assault at 100s. Assassin's Path is the one that has no cooldown to track — the wall does.
audit.corrected: All written in, including the Assassin's Path quirk in dosFull[0].d.

audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to their titles using the 575-range leap and the Blade's End bleed.

notes: FABRICATED ABILITY NAME: the content layer called Talon's ultimate 'Assassinate' in five separate fields and credited it with travelling through walls. His R is Shadow Assault (550 range, ring of blades plus invisibility); the terrain traversal is Assassin's Path (E, 725). Both errors are fixed. A second fabrication, Hwei 'W (Severance)' with a mid-dash root, was in wants.you[2] — Hwei's W subspells are Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection and Stirring Lights, and W shields rather than roots. CHART: all seven phases[N].side read 'Talon' against a content layer and packet chart that both read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei; realigned as one atomic group with no paired win[N] edits because win[N] already holds the correct token. RATINGS left untouched. WIN RATE: 48.25% over 2597 games is Hwei losing the matchup overall, which sits oddly under a level chart that hands Hwei five of seven rows — the chart is packet-backed so I followed it, but see questionsForUser.
